title: chore: remove CSS source
body: We don't use the CSS source of this project anymore but rely on InstantSearch.css.

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *algolia-instantsearch* ready!

Built with commit 233a6ab34095dadc7336a8326c31dc841e5bdc8a

https://deploy-preview-3235--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

@Haroenv Dev novel already uses InstantSearch.css: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/chore/remove-css-source/dev/template.html#L16

Docgen needs InstantSearch styles only for the widget showcase, which relies on InstantSearch 2 for now. We need to publish InstantSearch 3 beta and add the styles there afterwards: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/chore/remove-css-source/docgen/layouts/widget-showcase.pug#L6
hmm, indeed for a separate PR, but would be nice if it could come from source instead (although it barely matters since this docs site won't live for very long anymore)
I'm not sure it's worth the trouble to be honest.

@samouss I tried removing as many top-level dependencies as possible but we actually use them for the `dev/` folder and our stories.

We can still do another pass later.
